experiment.scope: Local physical effort maps, conjugate power, and explicit source feedback audit
experiment.source_channel_units_status: Dimensional interpretation of source hydraulic equations; converters serialize Unit=1; no hardware calibration
experiment.port_definition: Positive source-axis effort on follower with opposite effort on base
experiment.source_input_equation: e=D f + e_p0 f_p0; every complete experiment explicitly supplies f_p0
experiment.power_equation: e.T adot = tau_tree.T qdot = tau_reduced.T udot
experiment.distance_port_equation: A force conjugate to attachment distance maps through the actual distance gradient, not an assumed sign
experiment.rank_interpretation: Structural local rank after column normalization; global controllability and physical conditioning are not assessed
experiment.constraints: Ideal rigid loops; reduced and KKT solvers are RoboCompiler implementations
